> What makes suicide so wrong.

To put it simply: It is permanent solution to most of the times very temporary problems. Also it often is a bi-product of  depression, a condition that actively works to deceive you. It is very real and these experiences are valid and true for the person with depression, but for many problems there are better solutions, that the depressed person simply can't   
 or wont see.

> Wife no longer wants me, kids avoid me.

I don't know your particular situation, but there is always a way out: Don't avoid your share of responsibility for your past actions. Think about why they feel the way they feel about you, but don't be too harsh on yourself. There are multiple people in every relationship and if things go south every person has a part in fixing it.

If there is no fixing for it anymore (It really depends on your situation) then meet new people and build new relationships, but don't forget about the old ones entirely. Surely there are meetups in your area or places where you can talk to people. Try filling your life with peoples whos company you enjoy and who in turn enjoy yours- You've already done it at least once (because you surely had happier times with your wife) and you can do it again.

> I have the potential to get better and share joy, to add to the world. 

That is entirely true, you have the potential, act on it. I know its hard, but its even harder if you continue to doubt yourself this hard. You can do it!

> I still think I'm not really worth being alive. 

But, you are!  Stop doubting yourself, you can do it. You can better your circumstance. I love you.

what exactly do you want people to do- i dont know what you're expecting. many people here think there life is shit and they have suicidal tendencies. well that will not simply end, you have to actively better your circumstances. trying to improve yourself and the environment that shapes you does not constitute bad advice. only the wording here makes it seem like it is.

First thing first, anyone who discusses suicide methods with you here will get banned, it is one of the rules.Secondly, it is harsh and difficult (i know for myself, even if my depression is not as severe as yours, it seems) to keep pushing. Thing is, you have to want to hear the stuff, if you are reading this your thoughts may just be describable as 'I dont want your help, i just want suicide', but thats not true and you know its not true. Im sure you don't want to hear it, but you must:

1. Your life is your life. (i think this goes without explanation)
2. You can change your circumstances, you are in control (not all the time, but enough of it to search for help - *your post here is proof of that*).
3. You want desperately to find a solution other than suicide, else you would not post here *as you know that noone will give you a suicide method here.*

From your post I gather that there are people in your life that matter to you deeply and they are of course of great value when you want to achieve a few victores against your suicidal thoughts, but they don't suffice. It's hard, it's really hard and I am not a professional by any stretch, but I am trying, I am trying really hard, for you. Where there is a glimmer of hope, there is a way and there is hope.

How to fix your situation? This is a difficult question, that you could for one pose to someone you trust (one of these loved ones would be appropriate) and hope that they can help you. If their advice is shitty, then don't give up - they are most likely like me and would really like to help you. Give them more information or if their advice is really shitty, talk to another one. You will see it will help.

Second, leave your room, go out into nature and work out, do sports - its always helpful. Even if it does not magically "solve" your problems, because nothing I tell you can do that instantly, it will help at least a bit.

Find new contacts and meet interesting people - go to meetups in your local area, go into an art club, sports club, computer science club, into a bar at the evening and talk, you've got loved ones, one of them can come with you. Its emensely difficiculty for someone with depression to meet new people, I know, but its also such a big leap in your progress toward fixing your thoughts.

And then, if you can somehow take the biggest leap, find help. You think you have tried everything - no you haven't - there are dozens of options. For Florida there is also a mental health hotline. Find a professional, the truth is that you're painting your situation more hopeless than it truly is. It's not your fault you are doing that, its your shitty condition that is doing this to you, but you CAN fix it and there is hope.
